climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A North Carolina AVA of 868 square miles in the north-central part of the state, centered on Burlington and cut by the Haw River. It lies between Greensboro and Durham-Raleigh, and was created in 2009.
